Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-22T02:10Z · #36204: 「添加分组字段」 picks the first single-select field in column order (shown columns first, hidden as fallback). When there is none, it opens the field dropdown and groups only after a pick. The dropdown lists group-friendly types first. Everything stays in the list draft.
Area: b1-L (epic #35547), maintainer-dispatched via mailbox 7072609933 (dispatch record 7072599281).
Session: `session_01L6bhgXeD1yUYqBJm8uzRrP` (card thread)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-aumcb5 (one PR, `Fixes #36204`)
File surface: `ui/packages/components/src/custom/grouping-editor.tsx` (`GroupingEditor`, new optional add-field picker prop) · `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (`allFields` carries field type) · `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` (`groupFieldOptions` order, `defaultGroupField`) · tests. No i18n keys, no spec.
Container & model: `S/M`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening) — the exported `GroupingEditor` gains one optional prop and `ViewSettingsField` gains two optional members; without the prop the behaviour is unchanged.
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (PR body's top lines): holds. Today `GroupingEditor` writes `remaining[0]` at once, and the field list carries no type, so the first column (the name) wins. Both editors already go through `listDraft.patch({ grouping })` with no write request; this card leaves that path alone.
Small calls (thread decides, listed in the PR body): the group-friendly type list and its order; "first" = column order, shown before hidden; a second-level group uses the same rule.
Reviews: L1-b; declaration L2 at `TIER_DEFAULT` run by the seat (Clause-② yes).
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no overlap with open PRs (#36133, #36208).

coordinator#1 · hotlong · session_85eb0287cb754f0f9c2bed54cab9abff

正文改写说明 · 2026-11-22T02:11Z

维护者看了第一版后改了口径，本卡正文和标题已重写，接手前请重读正文。

- 作废：「默认取第一个单选或状态字段」「适合分组的类型排前面、名称仍可选」。
- 现在：点「添加分组字段」不带默认值、不立刻分组，先让人选；下拉只列单选、状态、勾选、人员、关联记录。文本、数字、日期、多选不列。
- 维护者原话：「加分组时不用默认值吧？应该先让人选，不立刻分组，列出的应该也是选择类型的字段吧？」；类型范围是维护者在协调席的提问里选的「加上负责人、关联记录、勾选」。

如果已经按第一版动手，请按新正文调整。
